cards.title: The average
cards.body: The average is the total divided by how many there are: `sum(nums) / len(nums)`. `/` always gives a decimal.

hi.title: Average
hi.body: Average matlab total ko ginti se divide karna: `sum(nums) / len(nums)`. `/` hamesha decimal deta hai.

cards.title: Counting matches
cards.body: Keep a counter and add 1 for every item that passes a test.

hi.title: Matches ginna
hi.body: Ek counter rakho aur har us item ke liye 1 jodo jo test pass karta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print the average, `5.0`, but prints `7.5`. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: Divide by how many numbers there are, not by 2: `sum(nums) / len(nums)` works for any list.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse average `5.0` print karna chahiye, par yeh `7.5` print karta hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: 2 se nahi, numbers ki ginti se divide karo: `sum(nums) / len(nums)` kisi bhi list ke liye chalta hai.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: The total is 6 and there are 3 numbers, so 6 / 3 is 2.0.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: Total 6 hai aur 3 numbers hain, isliye 6 / 3 = 2.0.
